items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: My brother was a bass player and my brother John was a guitar and a banjo player. But they all really was good and I used to listen to them all the time.

ctx.x: Did your father get you first or your brother?
My brother. Which one? John Marrera. You heard talk about John Marrera. He was a leading band you played.
Played with Solishtan a long time. John Marrera. With P. Ron too, didn't he? Yeah. He played with King Joe Oliver. You remember Joe Oliver? Yeah we had the records.
